pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal geometries with moderate-to-soft edge gradients. Dark regions on the mid-flank are larger and more cohesive, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented clusters toward the lower flank and ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively uniform across the mid-section, narrowing slightly at the intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible along the upper neck as a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour where the mane hair creates a distinct silhouette against the out-of-focus background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized vertical linear mark is visible on a large patch in the central-right portion of the flank, exhibiting a darker textural disruption compared to the surrounding fur.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced skeletal protrusion at the hip (tuber coxae) creates a sharp angular geometry and shadow on the upper posterior flank, altering the local patch topology.
